page.overview:
Who is Scarlet Valentine?

Scarlet is the wife of Funny Valentine and the first lady of the United States. She encounters Lucy during the President's questioning of every woman and child to find the traitor.

Scarlet Valentine is a slim woman with long dark hair she keeps tied into a ponytail with several rings. She wears a dark bodysuit partially quilted on the legs and bearing several crown symbols on the arms. Over that bodysuit, Scarlet wears a short sleeveless dress with a multi-layered heart motif on the chest.

Scarlet is a strong and ambitious woman. She is not shy at all and often takes the initiative. She has no trouble talking about her husband even when she is seducing a woman. Scarlet follows her impulses when in a relationship. She is blatantly bisexual, as she shows affection towards her husband, but also desires intimate contact with females. Along with a face sitting fetish.

She is shown to be sadistic as upon discovering Lucy's infiltration of her Husbands bedroom, she began to shoot at her and declared she would torture her slowly and make her suffer a long and painful death, even digging a Tubular Bells nail into her leg.
